project.name: @figma/my-make-file
project.description: Fuel 2.0 frontend: a React + Vite app for print/design workflows and onboarding, built from a Figma Make export with Tailwind and component libraries. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and product overview to understand Fuel 2.0 as a React/Vite founder and investor experience.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The HTML shell loads main.tsx, which mounts App — the view switcher for onboarding, scorecard, investor, and chat.

tour.title: Onboarding Journey
tour.description: Follow OnboardingFlow into FuelOnboardingChat and PatriotPayJourney to see how founder intake and narrative steps work.

tour.title: Scorecard & Credits
tour.description: ScorecardV2 presents intelligence insights while the credits module gates premium actions via CreditProvider and UpgradeModal.

tour.title: UI System & Tokens
tour.description: shadcn UI primitives plus Fuel design tokens and global styles keep the product visually consistent.
